graph.name: Codebit Elpro Cloud Architecture
graph.notes: Serverless containerized cloud architecture for Elpro temperature monitoring software, using AWS Fargate, Aurora Postgres on Graviton, EFS, and Transit Gateway for IoT and VPN connectivity.

nodes.name: USERS
nodes.notes: End users consuming the React single page application and REST APIs.

nodes.name: CLOUDFRONT
nodes.notes: CDN distribution providing secure worldwide access to the React web app.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing the static React single page application assets.

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Application Load Balancer exposing REST APIs to end users.

nodes.name: FARGATE
nodes.notes: AWS ECS Fargate running containerized microservices.

nodes.name: EFS

nodes.name: AURORA

nodes.name: IOT SENSOR

nodes.name: TRANSIT GW
nodes.notes: Central networking hub routing traffic across accounts and connectivity channels.

nodes.name: CLIENT VPN
nodes.notes: AWS Client VPN for secure remote administration.

nodes.name: User

edges.notes: End users request the web application via CloudFront.
CloudFront serves React SPA assets hosted in S3.
End users send API requests to the Application Load Balancer.
ALB routes incoming requests to microservices on ECS Fargate.
Fargate containers persist shared file state on EFS.
Fargate microservices query and update relational data in Aurora Postgres.
IoT sensors transmit temperature telemetry via 3G/4G to Site-to-Site VPN.
Site-to-Site VPN routes telemetry traffic into Transit Gateway.
Remote admin users connect through Client VPN.
Client VPN forwards administrative traffic to Transit Gateway.
